subject: Tournament
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
I was quite disheartened at that last tournament because the set up was good and it would have worked. The problem was that it had to be cancelled due to not having enough racers to join in and play. We already have three spots that were open to players to join in and no one was able to fill those spots. On top of that another three players cancelled due to family events, or because they just didnt feel like it, or because of the hurricane, and because I didnt get any responses from them. I understand that unexpected events do happen and it was quite a shame that this one couldnt go. We didnt have enough players to have a really good competition that I was hoping to achieve.

As stated I dont think anyone really cares about handicap there. There are players who complained that they didnt want to be in certain rooms because of handicap but I couldnt care less because thats a tournament and it is open to everyone.

I would like to create another tourney soon. But by the looks of things Revenge is pretty much dead. So the real challenge will be getting all of the players to know that there is a tournament underway and that they would be able to make it in. It would be great to have players from Burnoutaholics join in since very few tend to participate. I dont know why they dont participate, maybe its because they are intimidated? I dont know why they should be intimidated.. Im quite easy to get along with and so are the rest of the players that many consider "elites". Theyre all cool guys; vapor, rofer, sega, waterball, gt, roonige, silky, dark, kenny, ect. 

Maybe its because of the prize. The last 2 tournaments had prizes and people entered it. This last one didnt. Maybe that had something to do with the low turnout..
